content: 第三关（前）

speaker: Faust
content: Mephisto?

raw: [name="Faust"]  What was that you just unleashed? Your... team is more riled up than before.
speaker: Faust
content: What was that you just unleashed? Your... team is more riled up than before.

speaker: Faust
content: They're... they're in pain.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  Oh, you can tell? The seeds I planted have finally bloomed.
speaker: Mephisto
content: Oh, you can tell? The seeds I planted have finally bloomed.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  Nothing to worry about, Faust. They won't hurt us.
speaker: Mephisto
content: Nothing to worry about, Faust. They won't hurt us.

speaker: Faust
content: You're still catalyzing their infection?

raw: [name="Faust"]  Mephisto... just stop. We have a chance to survive.
speaker: Faust
content: Mephisto... just stop. We have a chance to survive.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  I am the only one who can perform such Arts! And it is only through my Arts that we can escape!
speaker: Mephisto
content: I am the only one who can perform such Arts! And it is only through my Arts that we can escape!

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  You saw with your own eyes. If we push through like this, the L. G. D. will kill us all long before we can reach the escape tunnel in the slums!
speaker: Mephisto
content: You saw with your own eyes. If we push through like this, the L. G. D. will kill us all long before we can reach the escape tunnel in the slums!

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  Have you ever seen those weapons before? Nobody in Chernobog had weapons like that!
speaker: Mephisto
content: Have you ever seen those weapons before? Nobody in Chernobog had weapons like that!

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  This is their city, they know it far better than us! Where did they come from? Where do they disappear to?! There's no way we can take them on with this few of us!
speaker: Mephisto
content: This is their city, they know it far better than us! Where did they come from? Where do they disappear to?! There's no way we can take them on with this few of us!

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  The Chernobog Ursus are too weak... Lungmen treats us like an army, but we're no army. We're just a group of like-minded individuals trying to survive!
speaker: Mephisto
content: The Chernobog Ursus are too weak... Lungmen treats us like an army, but we're no army. We're just a group of like-minded individuals trying to survive!

raw: [name="Faust"]  Quiet down. Morale is low enough.
speaker: Faust
content: Quiet down. Morale is low enough.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  But my herd will never waver in the face of such challenges!
speaker: Mephisto
content: But my herd will never waver in the face of such challenges!

raw: [name="Faust"]  ...not to mention all the Reunion members who just joined us.
speaker: Faust
content: ...not to mention all the Reunion members who just joined us.

speaker: Faust
content: FrostNova will definitely help us.

speaker: Mephisto
content: FrostNova? That FrostNova?

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  Hah! Hahah! As if she didn't take her Yetis and betray us?
speaker: Mephisto
content: Hah! Hahah! As if she didn't take her Yetis and betray us?

speaker: Faust
content: Mephisto!

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  If not, we can definitely crush our enemies with such strength!
speaker: Mephisto
content: If not, we can definitely crush our enemies with such strength!

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  But even if they did turn against us, I can't blame them for doing what it takes to survive.
speaker: Mephisto
content: But even if they did turn against us, I can't blame them for doing what it takes to survive.

raw: [name="Faust"]  FrostNova is no traitor. I told you. Look at the facts.
speaker: Faust
content: FrostNova is no traitor. I told you. Look at the facts.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  Indeed... we all do what it takes to survive.
speaker: Mephisto
content: Indeed... we all do what it takes to survive.

raw: [name="Faust"]  Just calm down, and don't go stumbling into the L. G. D.'s traps!
speaker: Faust
content: Just calm down, and don't go stumbling into the L. G. D.'s traps!

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  I have it under control, Faust. I will ensure the comfortable survival of all my people.
speaker: Mephisto
content: I have it under control, Faust. I will ensure the comfortable survival of all my people.

raw: [name="Faust"]  What...? What are you going to do?
speaker: Faust
content: What...? What are you going to do?

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  I'm going to show the L. G. D. something much more terrifying than an army. Just wait until they see the flowers that bloom from my people.
speaker: Mephisto
content: I'm going to show the L. G. D. something much more terrifying than an army. Just wait until they see the flowers that bloom from my people.

speaker: Faust
content: Mephisto?!

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  The L. G. D. must pay for their atrocities... And that Ch'en... She will pay for what she did to you!
speaker: Mephisto
content: The L. G. D. must pay for their atrocities... And that Ch'en... She will pay for what she did to you!

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  My comrades, my people, heed my words!
speaker: Mephisto
content: My comrades, my people, heed my words!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Mephisto"]  A magnificent vitality flourishes within you... Go forth and give in to your impulses, spread your seed, and seize your future!
speaker: Mephisto
content: A magnificent vitality flourishes within you... Go forth and give in to your impulses, spread your seed, and seize your future!

speaker: Faust
content: No, Mephisto!

speaker: Faust
content: They're living beings!

speaker: Mephisto's Herd
content: (Chaotic howling and shrieking).

speaker: Mephisto
content: All of Lungmen is your garden! Go, now, spread the life within you to all the people! Go, go, go!

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  They are far stronger than they were.
speaker: Mephisto
content: They are far stronger than they were.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  They can't hear my voice anymore, but they won't attack us again... They will grow stronger, more durable, and more numerous.
speaker: Mephisto
content: They can't hear my voice anymore, but they won't attack us again... They will grow stronger, more durable, and more numerous.

content: And they will completely consume Lungmen. Hah. If my people can't have this city, I certainly won't leave it to the Lungmenites!

content: Faust, come, it's time...

content: Faust?

content: What have you done?

content: (Pained wailing).

content: Faust? Where are you going?!

content: Faust!

speaker: Reunion Member
content: Why are Mephisto's people attacking us?!

speaker: Reunion Member
content: I saw it... It.. It was awful... Those things took Ivan... And... And then Ivan became like them!

content: Suka! What are you... some kind of monster?! They feel no pain. I stab them and they don't die!

content: They're getting stronger! We can't stop them!

speaker: Reunion Member
content: Faust?!

content: No! It might be one of Mephisto's traps!

speaker: Reunion Member
content: ...He saved my life.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Mephisto's a piece of shit. He might be okay.

content: Mephisto's a piece of shit. He might be okay.
